description: Tests from JSON-Schema-Test-Suite that are known to fail, with the reason. Each entry names a file, optionally a case (test-case description) and optionally a test (test description); omitted fields match everything. "regex": "std" limits an entry to builds with the std::regex backend (JSONSCHEMA_REGEX=std). "varies": true marks an outcome that differs by platform (for example between standard-library regex implementations): such a test may pass or fail. Regenerate candidates with jsonschema_suite_runner --emit-failures.
